title: Bluebonnet Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: With beach-inspired décor, hardwood floors throughout, Bluebonnet is a charming three-bedroom cottage located on the west side of town, conveniently close to the west side family pool.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: ▪️ 4 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes ▪️ 2 KING bedrooms ▪️ TVs in all bedrooms with cable/streaming capabilities ▪️ Access to the Private Seaside Beaches near PENSACOLA pavilion ▪️ You will have a total of 8 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Modica welcome basket for 7 night + stays (compliments of the owner) ▪️Spacious outdoor patios ▪️ Fully stocked kitchen complete with standard drip coffee maker ▪️ Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: → There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. → Vacation Cancellation Protection → Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) The upstairs opens into a spacious open plan living and dining area with 12ft ceilings with beachy blue and white decor. Several sofas, chairs, dining space, rugs, pillows and additional decor featured in the great room. The living area offers a 4K TV, DVD, Apple TV and board games. The modern kitchen is equipped with stainless appliances and is well stocked for those who enjoy cooking. Enjoy your meals at the indoor dining table or in the screened-in outdoor dining area. The upstairs also includes a full washer/dryer and full bath (shower/tub). Downstairs are three bedrooms, each with en-suite bathrooms as well as TVs. The Master includes a KING bed and walk-in closet (shower/tub · double vanity), the Guest room also has a KING bed and the custom DUAL Bunk room sleeps 4. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 8); All bedrooms are located on the first floor. 1st floor- ✦Bedroom 1: King master / private bathroom (bath/shower combo) with dual sinks. ✦Bedroom 2: Dual bunk room (sleeps 4) / private bathroom (shower only). ✦Bedroom 3: King / private bathroom (shower only). 2nd floor- Kitchen, Living area and Dining for 8 with Full Bathroom (Bath/shower combo) Bluebonnet is an inviting and relaxing Florida beach retreat located in the heart of Seaside proper with all of the modern conveniences you would hope to have while on vacation. Located on the west side of town, just steps from the western family pool, restaurants, chapel and shops. The Pensacola Pavilion is a short stroll away and offers access to the acclaimed sugar-white sand beach. Four (4) cruiser bikes are also included for our guests to enjoy all that 30A has to offer. IMPORTANT DETAILS: ✦ Parking for 2 cars ✦ There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. ✦ AMENITIES & EXTRAS: Hypoallergenic AC/Heat · Washer / Dryer · Kitchen Aid Mixer · Hair dryer · BBQ Grill · Outdoor shower · 4 Bikes · Beach toys · ✦Minimum age 25 for renters · Kid friendly · Pets and smoking not allowed ✦ Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. ✦ Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WIFI (upgraded speed)

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
